title: Determination Table: History Share in Penalty Relief
content:
On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the full penalty paid in a penalty relief request is multiplied by a history share. The history share follows the other late report penalties booked within the relief lookback, leaving out the penalty of the quarter being relieved.

| Other late report penalties booked within the relief lookback | History share |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.5 |
| Exactly one | 0.75 |
| None | 1 |

The relief lookback is counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the entry dates of the penalties in the account's balance history. Late report penalties booked for the quarter being relieved are left out of the count.

## Determinations (hypothetical accounts, penalty paid USD 180.00)

| Late report penalties within the relief lookback | Of which for the relieved quarter | Others | Share | Penalty paid multiplied by the share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 0.5 | 90.00 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0.75 | 135.00 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 180.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 0.5 | 90.00 |
